headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and easing — 43.6/100; Lombok Strait is the lead driver, -7% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **43.6/100** (**high**), down 2.0 pts week-over-week. 5 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Lombok Strait**, running **39.0/day** vs a normal of **42.0/day** (-7%).
**372** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **41% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$107.03/bbl** (-0.34% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$520.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$2.0M** cost-of-delay ($1.0M–$3.3M).
